system.description:
The plain hunter's road, and the hunters who take contracts on one beast, band or brood at a time: the monster-hunters of Treaty Hold, the fiend-hunters of Ordenvael and the bounty lodges of the Jinia Isles. No beast at your side and no druid's magic, just the mark, the trail and the kill.

  • Reshapes: Marked Prey.
  • Read the Quarry (1st): when you mark a creature, you learn its weakest save and any Resistance or vulnerability it has, and you have Advantage on checks to recall what it is and how it fights.
  • Contract (1st): before a hunt, name your quarry: one creature, or one band, brood or nest the GM agrees to.
  • Against your quarry you have Advantage on checks to track it, identify it or learn its habits and weaknesses, and if you tracked your quarry to the fight, one of them starts the encounter marked.
  • The contract ends when the quarry is dead or you give it up.
  • Lone Hunter (1st): Advantage on Survival checks when you hunt or travel alone or with one companion, and on checks to read a creature's size, number and wounds from its tracks.
  • Bring Down (5th): Hunter's Tricks gain a fourth option, Bring Down: the prey makes a Fortitude save against your Class Save DC or is knocked Prone.
  • Trophy (5th): when you slay your quarry, you may take a trophy from it. While you carry one (one at a time), creatures of the same kind roll morale twice against you and your allies and take the higher.
  • Twin Marks (9th): you may keep two creatures marked at once; Marked Prey's Advantage and Hunter's Tricks apply to either. Your quarry has Disadvantage on saves against your Hunter's Tricks and your traps.
